scope: User-authorized paired continuation, real-model zero-update gate before training

arms.grpo: Unchanged C-bounded with per-response effective-length loss mean
arms.fixed_length: Identical C-bounded with loss_type=dr_grpo, constant2048 length denominator

runtime: Shared frozen native-LoRA V1/eager path, newly initialized engine seed0 per process
no_update_gate: One real 32-response batch; short/long actual rows pass loss/backward under both reductions; no optimizer constructed; actor and PRM unchanged
evaluation: Source and both finals, same500-question validation set, greedy V1 native-LoRA, 2048 cap, original verifier
primary_comparison: fixed_length minus grpo validation accuracy with paired bootstrap
limitations: Native stochastic draws can differ despite identical seed
Question-level bootstrap is not training-seed uncertainty
Fixed-length reduction is not the full Dr.GRPO algorithm
